payload.claim: No test verifies that `_fail_write` actually removes the `/tmp` scratch file on a failed write (or that `_write_file`'s success-path `rm -f` at the end runs either). Deleting the `if scratch is not None:` cleanup block here still leaves every test in the diff green: `test_a_write_that_fails_does_not_leave_the_file_truncated` only checks the tracked file's bytes and `_porcelain(tmp_path)`, neither of which sees `/tmp`, and the new large-file test never exercises a failure path at all. The task notes explicitly flag this as the property nothing else can see ("The witness cannot see /tmp, so this rests on you"), yet no test holds it.
